name: vgi_worker_pool
description: List the VGI worker subprocesses currently pooled for reuse by this DuckDB process, one row per worker with its path, version info, `pid`, and idle age in seconds. Useful for capacity planning and spotting stale workers. Returns no rows for `launch:` / `unix://` transports, whose workers are pooled by the OS-level `AF_UNIX` socket rather than this DuckDB process.

returnsTable.name: worker_path
returnsTable.description: Executable path of the pooled worker.

returnsTable.name: data_version_spec
returnsTable.description: Data version the pooled worker reports.

returnsTable.name: implementation_version
returnsTable.description: Implementation version the pooled worker reports.

returnsTable.name: pid
returnsTable.description: Operating-system process id of the worker subprocess.

returnsTable.name: age_seconds
returnsTable.description: How long the worker has been alive in the pool, in seconds.

returnsTable.name: worker_path
returnsTable.description: Executable path of the worker.

returnsTable.name: hits
returnsTable.description: Number of times a pooled worker was reused for this path.

returnsTable.name: misses
returnsTable.description: Number of times a new worker had to be started for this path.

returnsTable.name: Success
returnsTable.description: True when the caches were cleared.

returnsTable.name: flushed
returnsTable.description: Number of subprocess-pooled workers that were flushed.

name: vgi_native_delegation_marker
description: Internal: a placeholder table function used by VGI's multi-branch scan rewriter to carry filter and projection pushdown before they are handed to the real worker-backed scan. It is never executed directly and is not part of the public API.
